import os, glob
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

# 1) Locate the dataset
candidates = []
for pattern in ["**/titanic*.csv", "**/titanic*.tsv"]:
    candidates += glob.glob(pattern, recursive=True)
candidates = sorted(set(candidates))
print("Candidates found:", candidates)
print("CWD:", os.getcwd())

if not candidates:
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "titanic.csv not found. Available CSVs at top levels:\n"
        + "\n".join(sorted(glob.glob('**/*.csv', recursive=True))[:50])
    )

DATA_PATH = candidates[0]
df = read_df(DATA_PATH)
print("\nLoaded:", DATA_PATH, "| shape:", df.shape)
